name: github-workflow-opencode-fix-and-retry-mcp-server
description: Monitor failing GitHub Actions workflows, auto-fix them with OpenCode, and retry the run — driven by a workflow_run webhook, coordinated through an MCP server.
long_description: When a workflow that opts in via a `# self-heal: true` marker in its YAML fails, a fix-and-retry chain is started: wait for the configured retry delays, run OpenCode on a worktree of the failing branch to produce a fix, push it, re-run the workflow, and on repeated failure open a GitHub issue. The MCP server surfaces the chains (list_chains, get_chain, pause_chain, resume_chain, retry_now, create_issue_now, set_config, health) to any MCP client.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List fix-and-retry chains, optionally filtered by state.

tools.name: get_chain
tools.description: Get a single chain by ID, or error if not found.

tools.name: retry_now
tools.description: Schedule a chain for immediate retry.

tools.name: pause_chain
tools.description: Pause a chain (only if running, waiting, or fix_error).

tools.name: create_issue_now
tools.description: Create a GitHub issue for a chain (requires GitHub client).

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Set a configuration override (gh_oc_auto or retry_delays_min).

tools.name: health
tools.description: Health check with DB status and chain counts.
